scope: A/A control: both retained engine slots run exact baseline bcadd binary. No candidate code runs during measurements.
slot_labels: baseline/lazy name the prior engine roles only; both use baseline binary during this experiment.
cache_scope: Existing independent volumes from completed A/B; same explicit local and Cloud generation primers, unequal earlier history preserved. Not cold, no forced GC.
mutation: Copy baseline binary into stopped original lazy slot only; preserve private original binary backup, restore while stopped in finally. Existing manifests and original trial evidence never modified.
commands: Two local native generation primers, two Cloud native generation primers, then three alternating Cloud pairs. No hidden CLI calls.
generation: Unchanged native Dang @generate consumes original input.txt; output removed each time, byte-exact correctness and 5ms visibility checks.
counter_scope: Cgroup/MemStats/PSI snapshots bracket CLI and include background work. Timers use blocking waitpid. One-second pacing excluded.
privacy: Normal approved Cloud login; no credential reads, no raw stdout publication. Local calls use empty XDG config without Cloud credentials.
